data: What is the maximum accuracy that the proposed method reaches across any number of dimensions?

The caption states that the figure shows "Accuracy vs. dimensionality of the representation." The x-axis represents the number of dimensions, while the y-axis represents accuracy. There are three lines in the graph representing three different methods: Proposed, GloVe, and NA. The blue line represents the Proposed method, which appears to reach its highest accuracy at approximately 73% across all dimensions. The green line represents GloVe, which has a lower accuracy than the Proposed method but remains relatively stable. The red line represents NA, which has the lowest accuracy and remains constant at 60%. Therefore, the maximum accuracy that the Proposed method reaches is approximately 73%.
